page_title: HAV 3-0 LOR | Le Havre v Lorient 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Yvon Mvogo. He makes it 3:0.
90+5' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
90+3' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
90+2' Lorient take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+2' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Arthur Desmas guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
88' Substitution. Loic Nego will be replaced by Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre).
88' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre) replaces Daler Kuzyaev.
88' That will be all from Nabil Alioui who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre).
86' The referee awards a corner and Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) goes over to take it.
85' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
84' Lorient quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Tosin Aiyegun (Lorient) is flagged for offside.
81' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but Arthur Desmas comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' Total attempts – 12:7.
76' Le Havre are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
72' Substitution. Julien Ponceau leaves the pitch and is replaced by Theo Le Bris (Lorient).
72' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Vincent Le Goff will be replaced by Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
72' Yassine Kechta comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).

70' 2 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) and Antoine Joujou gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 2:0.
70' 4:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
68' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
63' Substitution. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Andy Logbo walks off.
62' Julien Laporte (Lorient) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
62' Regis Le Bris prepares a substitution. Pablo Pagis is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
62' Here comes a substitution. Sirine Doucoure is given a rest as he is replaced by Tosin Aiyegun (Lorient).
60' Julien Laporte (Lorient) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) brings his opponent down. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The linesman raises his flag. Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) is adjudged offside.
53' 1 - 0 Goal! Loic Nego puts the ball on a plate for Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:0.
48' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
47' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) but poses no threat.
46' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Dembo Sylla comes on the pitch for Formose Mendy (Lorient).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre), but it's just over the bar.
44' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) prepares to take a corner kick.
44' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
43' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) tackles a bit over-zealously and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
39' A pass finds the feet of Pablo Pagis (Lorient) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
37' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arthur Desmas intercepts the ball.
33' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
31' Lorient work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
31' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
25' Two players stand over the free kick. Laurent Abergel (Lorient) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
22' The Lorient players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
19' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
19' Andy Logbo (Le Havre) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
15' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
15' The corner from Romain Faivre (Lorient) is intercepted by the defence.
14' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
13' Loic Nego (Le Havre) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
10' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) trips an opposition player and Romain Lissorgue signals a foul.
9' Some patient build-up play from Le Havre as they look to unlock the defence.
5' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
1' The match has just started.
